# TWM Advisory

Operating Performance Partner, Forward Deployed Engineer.

Site: https://www.twm.expert
Contact: tannous@twm.expert
Founder: Tannous Mekari (Président, TWM ADVISORY, SIREN 106 067 549)

## Positioning
TWM Advisory is an Operating Performance Partner. Work is done in a Forward Deployed Engineer posture: on site with client teams, from diagnosis to execution and measurement. Not remote slide decks.

## What we do
1. Cut avoidable costs
2. Free and redeploy capacity
3. Protect margin
4. Turn partner networks into growth systems (Partner Performance)
5. Give teams context, steering and product-building capacity (Performance OS)

## How we work
- Start from an economic priority
- Embed with teams
- Choose means after diagnosis (ops, partners, commerce, software/AI)
- Measure gains with finance before claiming results
- Fees can mix fixed and gain-share when attribution holds
